release_notes: Version 1.1.1: fresh installs now detect and use the app's bundled ffmpeg, so the video resolution picker offers the full ladder (including high-resolution merged video+audio) and those downloads complete correctly without a system-wide ffmpeg; faster, smoother UI with instant page switching, single-query sidebar and overview counters, idle capture polling that skips unchanged-database queries, and a progress-bar animation clock that idles when nothing is animating; and in-app documentation table-of-contents links now jump to the correct section.
